text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Praise for Bahrain in war against software piracy.
- Bahrain's Emir speaks of nation's pride in its loyal citizens.
- Changes in Bahraini investment climate urged.
- Bahrain to develop new port, industrial area.
- The Bahrain Training Institute is to spend 3.2 million dinars on training this year.
- Major oil firms to take part in the 10th Middle East Oil show in Bahrain later this month.
- Thailand's exports to Bahrain drop to $17.6 million in 1996 from $32.1 million in 1995.
- Bahrain's state security court continues trial of 81 suspects accused of plotting to topple the government by force.
- Sixty investment opportunities worth 400 million dinars to be offered at a seminar.
